question: To whom must the offering be given in the presence of the goddess?
premises: The recipients are deities presiding over the corpse
An offering is to be given to them
The instruction is addressed to the lady of the gods
inference: One should give the offering to the deities presiding over the corpse, O lady of the gods.
plain_english: O lady of the gods, one should give the offering to the deities presiding over the corpse.
